entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
California Polytechnic State University (Cal Poly San Luis Obispo, Cal Poly SLO, founded 1901) is a public polytechnic university in San Luis Obispo, California, part of the California State University system — and one of America's premier polytechnic universities, known for its 'learn by doing' philosophy, consistently ranked among the top public universities in the western United States, and producing graduates who have disproportionate impact in engineering, architecture, agriculture, and technology sectors.

Cal Poly San Luis Obispo's founding in 1901 as a polytechnic school reflected the late 19th-century American conviction that practical technical and agricultural education was as important as classical liberal arts for national development. The California Polytechnic School was established to provide hands-on agricultural and mechanical education at a time when California's economy was dominated by farming and natural resource industries. This practical educational philosophy was institutionalized in Cal Poly's motto 'Discere Faciendo' (learn by doing).

Cal Poly's modern reputation is exceptional among public universities: consistently ranked first or second among western regional comprehensive universities (U.S. News), its engineering, architecture, and agriculture programs are among the nation's best. The university's distinctive model — combining professional education with genuine hands-on learning through student farms, engineering projects, and studio-based architecture programs — has made it highly sought-after with admission rates that rival selective private universities. Its graduates' success in Silicon Valley and major technology companies has further enhanced its reputation.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: California Polytechnic State University — America's premier public polytechnic university, training engineers, architects, and agricultural scientists through distinctive hands-on learning, supplying Silicon Valley's technology economy with graduates — is historically significant as the most successful exemplar of practical polytechnic education in American public higher education.
